scope: Positive/adversary Track-L training source alternatives. No option is approved, acquired, executed, or used to authorize detector training in R6.

shared_requirements.formal_exclusion: FA1B2de, its 53 playbooks, 1796 raw actions, labels, outcomes, and copied action sequences are prohibited.
shared_requirements.label_boundary: Positive labels remain source/run/scenario manifest metadata and supervised targets; labels, action identity, playbook identity, and analyst annotations never enter the encoder.
shared_requirements.split_boundary: Whole host/run/scenario groups only under PROVX_R5_TRAIN_VALIDATION_SPLIT_CONTRACT.json; no event-level random splitting.
shared_requirements.feature_contract: Raw records must normalize to finite x [N,32] and edge_index [2,E] under provx-adapted-live-v1, with raw→normalized→graph→feature hashes.
shared_requirements.release_boundary: Acquisition approval is not training authorization; source integrity, split, contamination, class-count, encoder, and separate training gates remain required.

alternatives.source: Separately authorized, isolated, non-formal adversary emulation using the same collector as Stage B.
alternatives.scientific_value: Highest local causal compatibility: controlled positive labels, known scenario boundaries, and direct coverage of process/file/socket provenance in the Track-L live schema.
alternatives.preprocessing_storage_burden: MEDIUM-HIGH: scenario orchestration, collector completeness, causal linking, raw/graph/feature hash chains, isolation evidence, and retention; storage is bounded by a predeclared run/window cap.
alternatives.label_quality: HIGH if action-to-record alignment and scenario manifests are complete; quality must be audited and unsuccessful/incomplete scenarios are quarantined rather than relabeled.
leakage_risk: shared hosts or run IDs across partitions
literal action names or IDs entering command/path fields
alternatives.compatibility_risk: LOW-MEDIUM when the same collector and adapter are used; residual risk is collector loss, identity reconciliation, and causal-edge completeness.
alternatives.mininet_dependency: REQUIRES Stage-A E1C before live-route readiness/promotion, but emulation data cannot be admitted until its own authorization, safety, and compatibility gates pass.
alternatives.selection_rule: At least 12 whole scenario/host/run groups spanning credential_or_secret_access, discovery_and_enumeration, persistence_or_execution, and collection_or_network_activity; use fresh isolated hosts and fixed group IDs.

alternatives.source: Official FiveDirections OpTC data and red-team ground truth under PROVX_R5_OFFICIAL_CORPUS_SUBSET_ACQUISITION_DESIGN.json.
alternatives.scientific_value: High ecological validity and large-scale benign/positive background, with official red-team ground truth and endpoint eCAR semantics.
alternatives.preprocessing_storage_burden: HIGH: approximately terabyte-scale source, bounded object selection, eCAR normalization, errata handling, de-identification, causal graph construction, and storage ceilings of 20 GiB compressed/50 GiB expanded for the proposed subset.
alternatives.label_quality: MEDIUM-HIGH: official red-team ground truth is available, but alignment to 3600-second windows and object-level records requires an auditable join; unaligned background remains background.
leakage_risk: continuous benign traffic during red-team activity
shared background and duplicate process objects
alternatives.compatibility_risk: MEDIUM-HIGH: eCAR is only partially compatible; source-specific identity/causal-edge rules and the adapted 32D mapping require versioned normalization.
alternatives.mininet_dependency: No Mininet data dependency for source acquisition, but Stage-A E1C remains a separate Track-L live readiness dependency and official records must pass the same adapter compatibility checks.
alternatives.selection_rule: Use the frozen eight-host, two-benign-day plus one ground-truth-overlap-day, earliest passing 3600-second window rule; target 24 groups and stop if eligibility or caps fail.

alternatives.source: Official DARPA Transparent Computing Engagement #3 release under PROVX_R5_OFFICIAL_CORPUS_SUBSET_ACQUISITION_DESIGN.json.
alternatives.scientific_value: High provenance diversity across five TA1 performers and engagement-level adversary/background activity with documented good topics and ground truth.
alternatives.preprocessing_storage_burden: HIGH: external files, Avro/CDM decoding, performer-specific normalization, causal linking, timestamp/identity reconciliation, ground-truth alignment, and storage ceilings of 10 GiB compressed/30 GiB expanded for the proposed subset.
alternatives.label_quality: MEDIUM-HIGH: engagement ground truth and ACT annotations are documented, but performer/topic alignment and incomplete/invalid records require strict manifests.
alternatives.compatibility_risk: HIGH: CDM-to-R3 entity/event mapping, parser/schema pinning, and causal graph construction are not supplied by ProvX and must be independently versioned.
alternatives.mininet_dependency: No Mininet data dependency for source acquisition, but Stage-A E1C remains a separate live readiness dependency and the same 32D compatibility audit is mandatory.
alternatives.selection_rule: Use the first UTF-8-sorted good topic for each of cadets, clearscope, fivedirections, theia, and trace; select one earliest complete benign and one earliest ground-truth-overlap 3600-second window per topic; target 10 groups.

alternatives.source: Option A plus at most one bounded official fallback (Option B or C), with every source retaining separate manifests and group identities.
alternatives.scientific_value: Broadest coverage: local causal compatibility plus either large-scale endpoint diversity (OpTC) or multi-performer provenance diversity (TC E3). Supports a predeclared robustness/diversity comparison.
alternatives.preprocessing_storage_burden: HIGHEST: all Option-A burden plus one official-source normalization path; combined hard cap is 20 GiB compressed/50 GiB expanded for OpTC combination or 10 GiB compressed/30 GiB expanded for TC E3 combination, with no silent overflow.
alternatives.label_quality: Mixed and source-specific: Option A can be high-quality controlled labels; official labels are medium-high only after independent alignment. Source label provenance must remain distinguishable.
leakage_risk: shared background across local and official groups
alternatives.compatibility_risk: MEDIUM-HIGH: local source may be direct-compatible while official source remains partial/high-burden; a single frozen adapter contract and per-source normalization versions are required.
alternatives.mininet_dependency: Stage-A E1C is required for Track-L live readiness; Option A itself also requires isolated emulation authorization. Official fallback does not remove either dependency.
alternatives.selection_rule: Admit Option A's 12 scenario groups plus exactly one official design (Option B's 24 groups or Option C's 10 groups) under fixed caps, source-stratified group hashing, and no cross-source group merging.

comparison_authority.reason: It maximizes schema/collector compatibility and keeps acquisition bounded, subject to separate authorization and E1C readiness.
comparison_authority.fallback_rule: If Option A cannot meet class diversity or coverage without unsafe execution, a human may select Option B, Option C, or Option D only by recording an exact scope and accepting its source-specific burden.
comparison_authority.no_metric_selection: No option may be chosen using formal FA1B2de outcomes or unregistered detector metrics.
